builds.name: Reference: Dusk and Dawn
builds.goal: Reference for Locke: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: An attack-weaving magical skirmisher who consumes nail marks, uses a teleport-attack sequence to reach targets and chains takedowns through pursuit resets. Read the current Soul Nail consumption and E attack-dash rules. Test W self-health cost/healing and finite R execute stacks; repeated on-hits do not automatically repeat nails. Health/AP and a repeated-on-hit Spellblade attack test an attack-weaving melee pattern.
builds.summary: Health/AP and a repeated-on-hit Spellblade attack test an attack-weaving melee pattern.
testPlan: Kit question for Locke: Read the current Soul Nail consumption and E attack-dash rules. Test W self-health cost/healing and finite R execute stacks; repeated on-hits do not automatically repeat nails.

Start with the early core (Dusk and Dawn, then Riftmaker) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Health/AP and a repeated-on-hit Spellblade attack test an attack-weaving melee pattern. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

kitEvidence.formula:
Locke teleports to a location, dealing [40 / 50 / 60 / 70 / 80 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage to nearby enemies on arrival. 

On his next Attack, he dashes to his target, dealing [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage to all enemies in his path. Each hit consumes Soul Nails.

If Locke scores a takedown, the Cooldown of this Ability is reset.

Locke throws a binding artifact to a location, dealing [150 / 225 / 300 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage and Slowing enemies in the area by [99]%, decaying over [2] seconds. The artifact marks enemies hit for [5] seconds, sealing away marked enemy champions brought below [0.1 / 0.11 / 0.12 + (0.005) × BuffStacks({b5c3348f})], and resetting the duration of the mark on other affected champions.

After the duration ends, if at least one champion was sealed, the artifact lands on the ground. Locke can pick up the artifact to permanently increase its execution threshold by [0.5]%, and refund [20]% of his total Cooldown, for each champion sealed.

Locke ignites his own soul, gaining [characterLevelInterpolation(0.4 → 0.7; raw flags preserved)] Attack Speed and [0.4 + (0.0002) × AP] Move Speed that decays over [1 + 1] seconds.

For [6] seconds, he suffers [2]% current Health true damage per second but Heals back the last [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (1) × AP] damage taken, and an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 200; raw flags preserved) + (0.2) × AP] Health based on missing Health and time passed, up to a maximum of [UNRESOLVED({ee18a47b}; see calculationRaw) + (0.6) × AP] Health remaining.

Can be Recast to end early.

Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing [40 / 48 / 56 / 64 / 72 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage and marking enemies hit. Nails apply a [25]/[25]/[60]% Slow for [1]/[1]/[2] seconds, stacking with the amount of nails hit.

Attacking the enemy consumes the Soul Nails, dealing [(0.25 / 0.275 / 0.3 / 0.325 / 0.35) × AP + 18 / 26 / 34 / 42 / 50] magic damage per stack, increased by [20]% and [40]% for two and three nails respectively.

Locke's Attacks deal an additional [UNRESOLVED({ee18a47b}; see calculationRaw) + (0.1) × AP] magic damage on-hit, increased up to [UNRESOLVED({ee18a47b}; see calculationRaw) + (0.2) × AP] magic damage based on the target's missing Health.

builds.name: Nail Repeat Finish
builds.summary: Separate nail consumption, P and repeated on-hit packets.
builds.goal: Separate nail consumption, P and repeated on-hit packets.
builds.hypothesis: Q marks Soul Nails and actual attacks consume them for AP magic per stack with two/three-nail multipliers. P is a separate AP on-hit that rises with missing health; Nashor/Dusk rewards attacks while W supplies attack speed. R marks enemies for a finite execute threshold.
testPlan: Required state: Land three nails before attacking and record finite R artifact stacks.
Separate nail consumption, P and repeated on-hit packets; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Partial nail hits or unsafe W health loss outweigh follow-up damage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Dusk repetition does not recreate already-consumed Soul Nails.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
